items.title: Michael White interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 10, 2025
items.q: No personal interaction or relationship described between Michael White and Monk Rowe in the transcript.

ctx.x: Michael was interviewed via Zoom on July 10, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very happy to have Dr. Michael White from New Orleans here this morning. Thanks for joining me.
Oh good morning. It’s a pleasure.
